newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian president to Argentina for boosting trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian president to Argentina for boosting trade.

text.p: Tunisian President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali left Tunis on Monday on a three-day visit to Argentina to boost energy cooperation and trade, officials said.

Ben Ali's official visit to Buenos Aires follows a mission to Tunis last week by the president of the Argentine oil company Pluspetrol which has been exploring for oil onshore at El Ouara on the Tunisian-Libyan border since 1994.
Trade exchanges between Tunisia and Argentina rose to $108 million in 1996 from $28 million in 1995, Argentine Senate Speaker Eduardo Menem said in Tunis earlier this month.
Tunisian and Argentine diplomats said the two countries would seek during Ben Ali's visit to strengthen cooperation in energy, agriculture, tourism and shipping sectors.
It is Ben Ali's first visit to Argentina. Argentine President Carlos Menem visited Tunisia in 1991 and 1994.
